name: Postural Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS)

category.name: Vascular System
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating cardiologist or neurologist performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
It must specifically include if the diagnosis of POTS is:
Copies of any other treatment records or testing already performed by any providers for this or any similar condition by the treating physician.
Results from any testing already performed for the condition; and
Hospital records: History and Physical (H&P), operative notes, and discharge summary (if applicable).

rows.label: A

rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 12. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating cardiologist or neurologist performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 13. It must specifically include if the diagnosis of POTS is:
    • Confirmed;
    • Equivocal; or
    • Not confirmed
  • 14. Copies of any other treatment records or testing already performed by any providers for this or any similar condition by the treating physician.
  • Doctor's office notes;
  • Consultant notes;
  • Results from any testing already performed for the condition; and
  • Hospital records: History and Physical (H&P), operative notes, and discharge summary (if applicable).

Note: To rescind the diagnosis of POTS, submit an evaluation performed by:

• POTS center of excellence;

• A neurologist specializing in autonomic nervous system disorders; OR

• A researcher with extensive experience in POTS.
